lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: No ball tonight — just supper with young Lord Venture. Quieter, which means it's more dangerous, not less. Watch what the house says when it thinks no one important is listening.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: And if Elend asks something I can't answer as Valette?

lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: Then you smile and change the subject. He reads too much to be stupid — don't mistake him for harmless, either.
